statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), let R count actual induced rook-nine vertex sets once and put d_T=6-r_T. Suppose R=226, every d_T belongs to {0,1,2,3}, and exactly two actual deficiency-three triangles occur and are disjoint. Then the number b of actual deficiency-two triangles does not belong to {4,5,6}.
